import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error

d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv", parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["hour"] = ok["created"].dt.hour
X = pd.get_dummies(ok[["distance_km", "items", "hour", "courier", "weather", "shop_id"]], dtype=int)
y = ok["actual_min"]
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)


X_tr,X_val,y_tr,y_val=train_test_split(X_train,y_train,test_size=.2,random_state=0)
m=GradientBoostingRegressor(n_estimators=600,learning_rate=.1,max_depth=3,random_state=0).fit(X_tr,y_tr)
curve=[mean_absolute_error(y_val,p) for p in m.staged_predict(X_val)]
best_n=int(np.argmin(curve)+1)
final=GradientBoostingRegressor(n_estimators=best_n,learning_rate=.1,max_depth=3,random_state=0).fit(X_train,y_train)
test_mae=round(float(mean_absolute_error(y_test,final.predict(X_test))),2)
expect: Q1:  Остановка по валидации | base. Q2: вижу условие, заготовку и сдачу кода. Q3: Выберу best_n по отдельной валидации, переобучу все train и один раз оценю тест.

from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingRegressor

res = {}


d=pd.read_csv('deliveries.csv',parse_dates=['created'])
ok=d[d['actual_min'].between(1,299)].copy(); ok['hour']=ok['created'].dt.hour
cols=['distance_km','items','hour','courier','weather','shop_id']; cats=['courier','weather','shop_id']

 X_tr,X_te,y_tr,y_te=train_test_split(X,y,test_size=.25,random_state=42)
 m=HistGradientBoostingRegressor(max_iter=300,max_depth=3,categorical_features='from_dtype',random_state=0).fit(X_tr,y_tr)
 res[name]=(X.shape[1],round(float(mean_absolute_error(y_te,m.predict(X_te))),3))
n_categories=sum(ok[c].nunique() for c in cats)

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier, RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

g = pd.read_csv("guests_churn.csv")
y = g["churned"]
X = pd.get_dummies(g.drop(columns=["guest_id", "churned", "card_blocked"]), dtype=int)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)


hgb=HistGradientBoostingClassifier(learning_rate=.05,max_iter=300,max_depth=3,random_state=0).fit(X_train,y_train)
rf=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100,min_samples_leaf=5,random_state=0,n_jobs=1).fit(X_train.fillna(0),y_train)
auc_hgb=round(float(roc_auc_score(y_test,hgb.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1])),3)
auc_rf=round(float(roc_auc_score(y_test,rf.predict_proba(X_test.fillna(0))[:,1])),3)
nan_in_train=int(X_train.isna().sum().sum())
expect: Q1:  Бустинг без заполнения пропусков | plus. Q2: вижу условие, заготовку и сдачу кода. Q3: HGB примет NaN, RF получит выбранное заполнение0; AUC ожидаю около.93.

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

g = pd.read_csv("guests_churn.csv")
y = g["churned"]
X = pd.get_dummies(g.drop(columns=["guest_id", "churned", "card_blocked"]), dtype=int)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)


search=GridSearchCV(HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=200,random_state=0),{'learning_rate':[.05,.1],'max_depth':[2,3,5]},cv=3,scoring='roc_auc',n_jobs=1).fit(X_train,y_train)
best_params=search.best_params_
cv_auc=round(float(search.best_score_),3)
test_auc=round(float(roc_auc_score(y_test,search.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1])),3)
